subject: Generalized rate metrics — kickoff
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kickoff for the generalized rate metrics workstream, from our NeurIPS release on optimizing generalized rate metrics with three players. The setting: metrics and constraints built from rates — F-measure, KLD-based fairness measures — that standard loss minimization cannot target directly; the three-player formulation optimizes them with guarantees.

Product goal for data-platforms: constrained-metric training options in the platform, so teams can specify a fairness constraint next to their objective instead of hand-rolling Lagrangian hacks. Milestones: replicate the F-measure/COMPAS and KLD/Adult experiments by Mar 13, platform API design by Apr 3, pilot integration by Apr 30.

Gustavo, Fumiko, Halima, Oyin and Rafael are assigned.

Dmitri
